notes.notes:

Collector's Editions update 3.0
notes.notes:
Lord Captains!

We’re ready to provide you with a new update regarding Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader Collector's Editions and other physical items!

Every physical order is now being transported by ships from the place of production to the logistic centers where the distribution will begin. We’ve managed to get the ship’s tracking info, so now we would like to share the most detailed info on their current status.

[olist]
 EU ship
The EU ship departed on February 2nd, and should arrive in Rotterdam, Netherlands approximately on March 24th. Then the cargo should be transported to the warehouse on the 25th.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222021/4568da784a4e496a9fe113f040e82469d11cbcb0.png
 USA ship
The USA ship departed on February 2nd and arrived at Tacoma, WA on March 15th. On March 20 the cargo went by rail to Chicago and is scheduled to arrive there on March 25th. From there it should go to our warehouse.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222021/dac9b13c2f45854b15c2a35013bfeb17b1352c43.png
 UK ship
The UK ship departed on February 3rd, and has already arrived in Felixstowe, UK on the 18th. According to the plan, the cargo should arrive at the warehouse on the 21st of March.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222021/d949eaa8ebad202b15c2223df5b8646ea30781e1.png
[/olist]
Shortly after the ships reach the destination ports, the goods go through customs clearance procedures and are transported to the fulfillment centers. In the warehouses, the boxes will be checked, sorted, and prepared for individual shipment to our Lord Captains. This process will take some time, but we'll try to provide you with the tracking numbers on the website as soon as possible. We’ll keep you informed when the codes are available.

We are grateful to our founders for all the support, patience, and understanding, no matter what circumstances are interfering with the shipment! Thank you for being with us.

Collector's Editions update 2.0
notes.notes:
Lord Captains!

Unfortunately, due to increased international tensions in the Red Sea, our delivery of the Collector's Editions for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader has been delayed by a couple of weeks. 
We expect to provide you with the tracking numbers by the beginning of March and with the new expected delivery dates at around the end of the same month.

A few more details about the situation:

Your boxes are currently on their way from China, where they were manufactured, to logistical centers around the world. Distribution will commence from there. 
With the Suez Canal, a critical piece of maritime infrastructure, currently being too dangerous to use, ships are forced to go around the whole of Africa, affecting our deliveries as well. 

It will not affect the cost of your delivery or require any additional action from your side, but sadly there's nothing we can do to avoid this delay.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.102 is live!
Collector's Editions update and popular questions explained
notes.notes:
Lord Captain!

In today’s report, our crew officers addressed the most important questions that our Captains might need on their journey! We’ll tell you about our plans for the Collector's Editions distribution, remind you a couple of things about our website, and provide you with the answers to the most popular questions that you might have!

Collector’s Editions Update

We're happy to report that we are currently finalizing all the details on the Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader Collector's Editions shipment and preparing the packages for sending to their owners!

The shipment is planned to begin during the first week of February, so, please, check your address on the website once again. Please note that you may change your delivery address till January 31th! After that date, the addresses will be collected for the shipment and cannot be changed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222021/c5e6cf3b228d5eea17a8d9f292a012c0c3098676.png

According to the forecast of our Astropaths, all the packages should begin to arrive at their Lord Captains by the end of February or during the first half of March, depending on their location!

Q: Do I need to pay any taxes on the delivery?
A: No, all the taxes will be paid by us and were included in the cost of the Edition!

Q: If I ordered more than one product, can I get it in one parcel?
A: Sure, everything that you’ve ordered from one account will be delivered to you as one package!

Q: Will I get a tracking number for my package?
A: We’re working this question out right now and will report on it in the news with the shipment beginning announcement!

Q: I did not order the Collector's Edition, but I ordered a separate item (art book, hoodie, etc.). Does all this information apply to my order as well?
A: Yes, sure! All physical items (both Collector's Editions and individual items) will be sent out at the same time. 

Q: I also bought Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous Collector’s Edition, can I have both of them delivered together?
A: Unfortunately, no. Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader Collector's Editions were produced by another company and in another place so they should be shipped separately.

Q: Will the distribution of Rogue Trader Collector's Editions affect the distribution of Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous Collector’s Edition in any way?
A: No, it won't. The logistics processes of these Editions are different, and they do not affect each other in any way. Don't worry, the work on Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous Collector’s Edition shipment is going, and we'll surely share the news once we have them!

Stay tuned for the additional shipment announcement with all further details!

Website Checklist

https://roguetrader.owlcat.games/

If you pre-ordered the game on our website and did not redeem your key - you can do it already, the game is out!

To do it, log into your account and go to the Digital Download tab. There you can get your release key for the game! Please, note that you can choose any platform to your liking (consoles are included).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222021/dc62fccd2941c1c3356e26d6eb1fcf68cb22eeaf.png

All digital rewards are already available on the website in your account, in the Digital Download tab! 

Q: The beta was taken from my account, what should I do?
A: The beta was a separate project, it was removed from the store before the release. You need to get a new release key in your account on the website. 

Q: My Edition had digital rewards, where can I get them?
A: All digital rewards are already available and can be claimed on the website in your account, in the Digital Download tab!

Q: My name is missing from the credits or Shrine of Remembrance! What should I do?
A: Warp machinations are sly and some names can be missing from the credits or Shrine of Remembrance. If you notice that, first make sure that you’ve put your name on the website in your account. Also, when you check it in the game, please, remember that the name you’ve put in the Credits Name section should be displayed in the game, not your Discord name! If you’re not sure which name to search, check it in your account on the website again!
(Please, note, that if you bought Core Digital Pack, your name should not be in the credits)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222021/18feefad421b742bcaf260fe49c39b3737d6fa3c.png

When you do that, please, contact us via e-mail: team@owlcat.games or create a ticket on our Discord Server! Describe your problem and don’t forget to attach your email! We’ll check everything and make sure your name is delivered in the game where it should be!

Q: My pack granted me exclusive items, such as a new throne model or a new voidship. How do I choose them in the game?
A: When you activate your additional pack key, the items will be added to the game automatically. The throne model will be changed to the new one. And the alternative voidship can be selected in the character creation menu at the beginning of the game!

The report is over, Lord Captain. We’re ready for the next warp jump!

notes.title: A pre-release checkup
notes.notes:
Greetings, Lord Captain!

We are pleased to inform you that the release of Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader is getting closer. The journey into the depths of the Koronus Expanse will begin as early as December 7, 2023. Are you ready? Make sure you are with our checklist.

And get ready to claim your brand new game key - these are available, starting on December 4.

If you purchased one of the editions of the game at roguetrader.owlcat.games, then log in to your account. If you forgot your password and have trouble recovering it, please contact team@owlcat.games - we will help you.

After that, check the Digital Downloads tab: there you will be able to obtain the game key. You will be able to activate the game on the following platforms: PC or Mac.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222021/5cb758f18de1992c5e706c3627997c5f8f0d4cec.png
As for now, the keys for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X / S are not available - they will become available right on the day of the release. The same stays for the GOG keys on the PC - they will be available on December, 7. Important note: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader is NOT optimized for PlayStation 4 and the older versions of the Xbox.

If you choose to activate the key on PC, you will be able to select between a key for Steam or EGS. Please be careful: once you have obtained a key for a particular platform, you will not be able to switch back and replace, for example, a Steam key with a EGS key.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222021/926e67e2aabf187f29ecfb1d70db5def74204313.png
After receiving the key, you will be able to activate it in the corresponding program or launcher. Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader will appear in your game list. You will be able to download the game only starting from the release day, the 7th of December.

If after purchasing one of the editions of the game you have a promo code for the portal, please note: it is intended to be activated by another user.

That's all for now. See you in the Koronus Expanse, Lord Captain!

notes.title: Warhammer 40k Rogue Trader release date set for December
notes.notes:
The Warhammer 40k Rogue Trader release date is set by developer Owlcat Games. The CRPG is looking like it might be one of the best Warhammer 40k games in a while, and fortunately we won't be waiting too long to play it. Built by the team behind Pathfinder videogame Wrath of the Righteous and based on the tabletop RPG of the same name, Warhammer 40k Rogue Trader promises to follow in the footsteps of Baldur's Gate 3 in delivering faithful tabletop adaptations.
